entries.name: railyard-trace backward, from a position in what was built.maps the built position to its source through the map, and from there to the artifacts
railyard-trace backward, from a position in what was built.says a source that lies outside the root, and a built file that is not there
railyard-trace backward, from a position in what was built.says where the map itself gives no source position for the built position
railyard-trace backward, from a position in what was built.traces code with no source map at its own position
railyard-trace backward, from a symbols file.answers at a column, and says untraced where the position traces to nothing
railyard-trace backward, from a symbols file.answers the build it is given, and never a link from another version
railyard-trace backward, from a symbols file.answers the newest version when no build is given
railyard-trace backward, from a symbols file.answers the position from the symbols file, says so, and names the version it read
railyard-trace backward, from a symbols file.refuses a build the directory does not carry, naming it, and a symbols directory that is not there
railyard-trace backward, where the repository is gone.answers from the symbols file alone, with no repository to read
railyard-trace backward, with no root given.resolves a mapped source against the root the symbols directory records
